# Inconsolata

Static regular face from the official Inconsolata repository at tag `v3.000`
(commit `d7269b53386323faad00cc7eebb3d99d26d103ff`):

`https://github.com/googlefonts/Inconsolata/tree/v3.000/fonts/ttf`

The embedded family is registered as `Inconsolata` at weight 400. The file is
unmodified; `OFL.txt` is the upstream SIL Open Font License 1.1 notice.
